findings.detail: June 3 detail tables contain 624 futures and 12886 options, exactly the positive-volume contract subsets of the full June 3 bhavcopy. All matched OHLC, contract volumes and trade counts agree; traded quantity equals volume times dated lot size. Inactive contracts are absent, not zero-OI evidence.

The two futures files share keys and all other normalized fields, but 66 TRD_VAL values differ. Plain fo03062026.csv stores the NIFTY June30 turnover as 1.98561E+11 versus 198560806808.00 in copy (2), a 193192 difference. Copy (2) turnover matches all 624 bhavcopy values; preserve both originals and do not call them semantically identical.

Against full bhavcopy, overlapping OI differs for 171 futures and 278 options. The report footnote identifies trading-system end-of-hours OI but does not resolve causation or which basis each consumer requires. Excluded inactive contracts include 15 futures and 5146 options with nonzero OI. No basis is silently substituted.

The PCR-named file stores SYMBOL/CE/PE, not a ratio. All 216 CE/PE pairs reproduce active report sums; none equals full-bhavcopy sums. Coverage and overlapping OI differences both matter. PE/CE examples are audit calculations, not live signals or validated complete-market PCR.

Option NOTION_VAL empirically matches bhavcopy TtlTrfVal for all12886 overlap rows; premium PR_VAL does not. Contracts, quantity, rupees and crore fields remain distinct. This dated empirical mapping is not a general official schema/unit contract.

Saved pack-summary row/type counts include footnotes: actual data counts are624/12886 with2 instrument types each. Twenty-four option-index rows contain5 symbols; grouped contract/quantity/OI totals reconcile but a single-expiry interpretation could not be established. Do not deduplicate on symbol alone. The empty volatility-futures table is source absence, not a current no-market declaration.

Stock summary and top-option differences are small fractional-rupee values; index/product crore totals have unresolved differences, so not all discrepancies are dismissed as one rounding step. Top10/20 contracts match contract-volume order; footers22%/7% align with value shares about21.82%/7.12%, not contract shares27.40%/10.47%.

Binary XLS contains12 connected-entity group records datedJune1, notJune3: grossOI percentage is neither ownership nor FII net flow, and unknown group membership prevents unique-client aggregation. No numerator/denominator exists to recompute source percentages.
